source_caption_text:
Estelle shares her 1 BILLION streams plaque for “American Boy” with Ye 🔥🙏

Estelle is celebrating “American Boy” surpassing 1 billion streams on Spotify 🏆🔥

Released in 2008 as part of her album Shine, the track paired Estelle’s smooth vocals with a memorable verse from Ye. Its upbeat production and instantly recognizable hook helped make it a global hit, reaching No. 1 on the UK Singles Chart and breaking into the U.S. Top 10. 

The song also won the 2009 Grammy for Best Rap/Sung Collaboration, giving Estelle and Ye one of the biggest records of their careers. Nearly two decades later, “American Boy” is still finding new listeners and adding to its legacy as a timeless collab. 

Via; @estelledarlings
